verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce is payments and commerce infrastructure that agents call. It is not an agent host that consumes external tools, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the server role, an official Stripe MCP server that other agents connect to. That does not make the client story applicable and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
